purpose: Establish what is known and unresolved about the source geometry, candidate teacher capabilities, training ancestry and license scope before any teacher artifact is downloaded or executed.

source_license_receipt.scope: Project-local TRAIN-only research use within the bound ARKitScenes terms; redistribution is not authorized. Any materially new source operation requires a separately reviewed receipt.

source_context.blocking_reason: B0 proves raw trajectory/intrinsics/depth capability, but the current DCA target atlas does not materialize explicit timestamp or pose transforms and no AG-ST anchor-versus-hidden-truth adapter receipt exists. Source-native data is evidence, not automatically valid truth in every pixel.

known: The released training pipeline lists 13 supported training datasets and includes ScanNet++ v2.
The official training guide declares DINOv2 initialization.
unknown: Exact per-example ancestry of each released checkpoint.
Exact dataset composition of the chosen default versus Apache checkpoint until its pinned model card and revision are archived.

known: The DA3 paper explicitly names ARKitScenes among real-world depth-camera training sources.
The paper describes dense teacher pseudo-depth aligned to original sparse or noisy depth for real-world data.
The official repository says -1.1 checkpoints repair a training bug and are preferred over deprecated original Large/Giant/Nested checkpoints.

candidate_teachers.confidence_semantics: Estimated scale-invariant log error used as within-input relative ranking; it has no absolute heteroscedastic-probability meaning.

candidate_teachers.schema_boundary: Dense surface normal may be used only as a gate or deterministic-derivation diagnostic. The current R2 F1 schema contains support-plane normal, not a dense normal supervision field.

excluded_from_initial_r0.reason: A semantic mask proposal does not establish metric physical discontinuity, support validity or UNKNOWN. No segmentation model is admitted in Stage 0A or 0B.

dependency_and_independence_findings: Teacher agreement is correlated evidence, never a vote count or independent truth.
DA3 and UniDepthV2 have direct ARKitScenes-family training overlap with the candidate source family.
MapAnything and UniDepthV2 have known ScanNet++ ancestry overlap.
MapAnything and DA3 both rely on large pretrained visual backbones, so shared prior failure remains plausible even without a named source overlap.
Teacher confidence, disagreement and reprojection residual are candidate gate features only; none is factor sigma truth.

required_before_any_download_or_inferenc: archived model card and license text SHA256
declared source and checkpoint ancestry status

blockers: No exact teacher revision, checkpoint SHA256, transform or dependency lock exists.
No AG-ST RGB/K/pose/depth adapter and anchor-versus-hidden-truth receipt exists.
No exact factor-specific parent role roster or deterministic withholding mask ledger exists; the current joint factor bundle reaches only 10 parents.
No factor-specific risk ceilings, minimum denominators or minimum useful selective coverage values are frozen.
Continuous physical-boundary and support transforms for hidden registered geometry are not frozen.
claim_ceiling: Official-document and existing-repository audit only. It supports freezing an AG-ST R0 selective-labelability protocol, but establishes no teacher independence, label correctness, calibrated uncertainty, pseudo-label admission, F1 supervision-frontdoor satisfaction, training, deployment, product or safety authority.
